11083|74fbc2b7.name: Darianna
11083|74fbc2b7.text: If you're interested in sewing with leather, you've certainly come to the right place. Faldron and Telonis are true artists, and I hope to learn much from them.

3306|0e051c59.name: Keldas
3306|0e051c59.text: You've come for training in order to pass it on to your pets?

3571|2a249ced.name: Dolanaar Sentinel
3571|2a249ced.text: You will find numerous trainers around Dolanaar with ages of experience with which to tutor you.  Which would you have me point you to?

3571|2e951586.name: Dolanaar Sentinel
3571|2e951586.text: Nadyia has made quite the leatherworker in her years of practice.  Travel west on the road to Darnassus to pay her a visit and maybe she can bestow some of her knowledge upon you.

3571|3f08fa2f.name: Dolanaar Sentinel
3571|3f08fa2f.text: Dazalar is well known around Dolanaar for his hunting skill.  Why don't you talk to him and see what he can teach you?

3571|75932d8c.name: Dolanaar Sentinel
3571|75932d8c.text: The Timberlings have made it too difficult for the fishermen to catch anything around Dolanaar.  You best look for someone to train you in Darnassus.

3598|c8e02354.name: Kyra Windblade
3598|c8e02354.text: I do not see the warrior's spirit within you, child.  I have no teachings which would benefit a $c such as yourself.

4146|08830bac.name: Jocaste
4146|08830bac.text: Through rigorous retraining I have had to break many students of all they had previously learned so that I might teach them anew.  The service I offer becomes increasingly difficult to perform each time it is done.  It is for that reason that it becomes increasingly expensive with each retraining.  Do you desire that I break you of the talents you have learned?

4262|12086219.name: Darnassus Sentinel
4262|12086219.text: A time consuming, yet rewarding skill.  Speak with Astaia in the Tradesman's Terrace and maybe you'll learn something useful.

4262|84b403e6.name: Darnassus Sentinel
4262|84b403e6.text: Astaia has fished up some curious treasures over the ages she has spent fishing.  Why don't you go see her over in the Tradesman's terrace and have her show you some of them.

4262|e07232c6.name: Darnassus Sentinel
4262|e07232c6.text: Here among the craftsmen of Darnassus, there is a millenium of knowledge for the benefit of your chosen craft.  Now tell me, which craft do you find the most intriguing?

4262|e66389a6.name: Darnassus Sentinel
4262|e66389a6.text: One has opened up on the Tradesman's Terrace.  If you take the path leading Southeast from the bank, it should be easy to find.

4262|f71d5637.name: Darnassus Sentinel
4262|f71d5637.text: The skill with which Telonis crafts armor is beyond compare.  You should be grateful that he does not charge more for the knowledge he passes to others.  Go now and seek him out in the Craftsmen's Terrace in the northeast section of Darnassus.

6736|ed5e81b7.name: Innkeeper Keldamyr
6736|ed5e81b7.text:
What can you do at an inn?

Well when you stay at an inn, you rest very comfortably.  Because of this, you will become "well rested" much more quickly than you would in the wilderness.  When you are well rested, you learn more from experience.

You may also speak with any innkeeper to get a hearthstone, and can later use the hearthstone in order to quickly return to that inn.

2438-progress.name: Tallonkai Swiftroot
2438-progress.text:
Please move swiftly. I can only hope that my emerald dreamcatcher has been unharmed by the furbolg.

Have you recovered it yet, $N?
2438-progress.title: The Emerald Dreamcatcher

2498-accept.name: Rellian Greenspyre
2498-accept.text:
I have just received word that  Denalan at Lake Al'Ameth has discovered what may be the cause of the tumors that plague the timberlings. Please speak with him, and tell him I sent you.

Make haste, $N; he needs our help.
2498-accept.title: Return to Denalan

4161-progress.name: Zarrin
4161-progress.text: Remember the balance, $N. I wish you to develop an understanding and a strong empathy for the living forests.
4161-progress.title: Recipe of the Kaldorei

488-progress.name: Zenn Foulhoof
488-progress.text: Have you been a busy little bee, $N?  I've been waiting for you to bring me what I need.
488-progress.title: Zenn's Bidding

489-progress.name: Zenn Foulhoof
489-progress.text: What do you have for me, $N?  A lovely snack I presume?
489-progress.title: Seek Redemption!

6071-accept.name: Jocaste
6071-accept.text:
Hello, young $c. You look to me like you are skilled enough to handle a beast and train it as your companion.

You must see Dazalar in Dolanaar. He can put you on the path to earning a pet of your own.
6071-accept.title: The Hunter's Path

87288-progress.name: Aldia
87288-progress.text: It is good to see you again! Are you here to trade?
87288-progress.title: Soft Saber Pelts

918-progress.name: Denalan
918-progress.text: Do you have the seeds?  I am eager to plant them.
918-progress.title: Timberling Seeds

919-progress.name: Denalan
919-progress.text: Hello, $N.  Have you found any sprouts near the waters?
919-progress.title: Timberling Sprouts

922-progress.name: Rellian Greenspyre
922-progress.text:
Hello...

And how may I help you?
922-progress.title: Rellian Greenspyre

923-complete.name: Rellian Greenspyre
923-complete.text:
Well done!  These tumors are the symptom of the timberling's disease.  They are filled with a poison that we must cleanse from our new land.

I will dispose of these tumors.  Thank you, $N.
923-complete.title: Tumors

923-progress.name: Rellian Greenspyre
923-progress.text: Have you been to Wellspring Lake, $N?  Have you been hunting the timberlings there?
923-progress.title: Tumors

928-progress.name: Corithras Moonrage
928-progress.text: Greetings, $c. For what purpose do I owe the pleasure of our meeting?
928-progress.title: Crown of the Earth

929-progress.name: Corithras Moonrage
929-progress.text: Hello again, $N. Have you completed your task?
929-progress.title: Crown of the Earth

933-progress.name: Corithras Moonrage
933-progress.text: At first the reports of crazed furbolg attacks were dismissed. Who could have thought that the peace-loving bear-men would turn to mindless rage? Yet another of the problems that plagues us here in our new home.
933-progress.title: Crown of the Earth

97949-complete.name: Radnaal Maneweaver
97949-complete.text:
There you have it, you can now craft your very own Camp Chair. Most folk don't care much for camps being set up in the center of town, so you'll need to head into the wilderness if you want to test it out.

Oh, and just remember, no camp is complete without a campfire. You'll need one of those before you start up your camp. Most cooks can teach you to make a fire. If you haven't already, you might want to check in with someone who can train you in the culinary arts to learn the basics.
97949-complete.title: Camping 101: Skinning

997-complete.name: Denalan
997-complete.text:
Ah, it's here!  I have waited for this rare earth for quite some time.  I hope it's still fresh...

Thank you for bringing it to me, $N.  You are a $r who is generous with her time.
997-complete.title: Denalan's Earth
